# Mimaura

> Mimaura is a calm, emotionally intelligent wellness companion that helps women and neurodivergent minds learn their body's patterns through gentle, non-prescriptive nudges.

Mimaura tracks cycles, moods, energy, and symptoms — then surfaces patterns and soft insights via Mimi, an AI companion designed to be ADHD-friendly, low-stim, and inclusive of chronic conditions.
